#### 1. anterior segment dysgenesis 1  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.683)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:9006)

**Proposed mechanism:** PITX3 (HGNC:9006) —DISRUPTS→ Embryonic lens and anterior eye development (GO:0001701); Embryonic lens and anterior eye development (GO:0001701) —LEADS_TO→ Lens dislocation, posterior polymorphous corneal dystrophy 3 (MONDO:0012527); Embryonic lens and anterior eye development (GO:0001701) —LEADS_TO→ Anterior segment dysgenesis 1 (MONDO:0007138).
